LanguageData.RimTouch.EnableTouchModeDesc: Enables RimTouch direct touch gestures and UI tap repair.
LanguageData.RimTouch.EnableGlobeTwistDesc: Turn two fingers to roll the world view. A deliberate twist releases the world's north-up lock. Use North-up in the world view to straighten it again.
LanguageData.RimTouch.TwistCommitDegreesDesc: How far two fingers must twist (in degrees) before the globe starts rotating. Higher values make accidental rotation during pinch-zoom or drag much less likely; once a gesture is clearly a pinch or a drag, rotation is locked out for that gesture.
LanguageData.RimTouch.LockNorthUpOnDrag: Lock north up while dragging the globe
LanguageData.RimTouch.LockNorthUpOnDragDesc: Dragging the globe with one finger no longer rolls the view: a straight drag only pans, and dragging in a circle does not spin it. North keeps whatever direction it had when the drag started (north-up stays north-up). Turn off to keep the free globe-spinning drag.
LanguageData.RimTouch.TurntableDragSensitivityDesc: How fast the globe turns when you drag with one finger (turntable mode only). 1.00x is the default; lower values make dragging slower and more precise, higher values make it faster. Only applies while 'Lock north up while dragging' is on.
LanguageData.RimTouch.AllowExtraUiScalesDesc: Opt in to scales outside the game's normal resolution checks. Turn this off to restore the native scale choices.
LanguageData.RimTouch.ExtraScalesUnavailable: Extra scales are unavailable on this game build; native scale limits apply.
LanguageData.RimTouch.ExtendedZoomRangeNote: Extended zoom range. Disabling restores prior bounds if this mod still owns them.
LanguageData.RimTouch.EnableExtendedZoomRangeDesc: Lets you zoom in closer and out further than vanilla allows.
